friedman.method: Friedman on matched daily hub failure rates in gap 60–120

wilcoxon.method: paired daily ATL morning/evening failure rates

caveats: Exploratory analyses; repeated use of training data
Matched days address pairing but not serial dependence between days
Wilcoxon additionally assumes symmetric daily differences for its location interpretation
Friedman compares daily ranks; it does not identify causal hub effects
Original Kruskal-Wallis/Mann-Whitney p-values are not used for independent-sample inference
